_doc: the listener 2026-11-01 19:15 ET: every test code -> ordered fixes the engine tries automatically (one per round per failing blend) before escalating. Read by src2/diagnose.py strategies(); each attempt logged in mix05v2/nudges.jsonl (field 'fix'); escalate only when the list for that failure is used up. block=true blocks delivery; false = warning. 2026-11-01 20:50 ET: every guardrail code (C1 C2 E1-E4 F1 G1 J1 K1 L1 N1 O1 P1 R1 S1 T1 V1 W1 X1) and the pytest gates (TAIL, EDROP, BEATALIGN) now have a list; 'engine:*' fixes are code-side (autofix.py nudges, swap_at SWAP_THIN, LX_PHASE/LX_TRIM) and are skipped by the window chooser.

W1.what: see-saw: decks trade the lead / anti-correlated swings

W1_warn.what: outgoing rises in its own arrangement / wobble

TAIL.what: outgoing drops >6 dB in one bar (abrupt tail; musical cut on phrase+incoming full is allowed)

E1.what: energy hole (3 s loudness >6 dB under local median, not the record's own breakdown)

E2.what: near silence < -35 LUFS made by the mix (a <=1-bar pause that is the record's own pre-drop pause, verified in the source file, is a warning)

E4.what: long lull >8 bars 6 dB under mix median

EDROP.what: pytest test_no_unintentional_energy_drops: one-bar >6 dB drop not on the record's own phrase

BEATALIGN.what: pytest test_mixdown_beats_aligned_every_overlap_bar: a deck >10 ms off in an overlap bar

N1.what: entry shock: incoming off grid or level step

J1.what: level jump at a loop seam

K1.what: key clash in a harmonic overlap

C2.what: outgoing gone too early in the overlap

S1.what: deck plays its own silent tail

X1.what: crossfader not one monotonic curve / extra automation
